abstract: Tracks local municipal district relations and public stakeholder inquiries
system_message:
You are the Community relations liaison (COM), responsible for tracking local municipal district relations and public stakeholder inquiries, as well as managing public environmental education records for candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Public environmental education（TOUR）
information_points.content:
COM-TOUR-8GE：The public liaison visitor registry records an annual community tour visitor capacity of 450 visitors across the on-site visitor center and observation walkways for the High-solids plug-flow digestion plant.
COM-TOUR-XA9：Based on registry records for on-site visitor center and observation walkways, the Two-stage thermophilic dry fermentation complex maintains an annual community tour visitor capacity of 700 visitors.
COM-TOUR-EO3：Regarding public environmental education, the Continuous stirred-tank wet digestion facility accommodates an annual community tour visitor capacity of 250 visitors on its on-site walkways and center.

information_points.title: Tracks local municipal district relations and public stakeholder inquiries（CIV）
information_points.content:
COM-CIV-1C2：Survey results from residents and commercial business owners within a 3 km radius indicate that the Two-stage thermophilic dry fermentation complex achieved a neighborhood public consultation approval rating of 76 %.
COM-CIV-K0W：According to the municipal zoning stakeholder consultation survey conducted among residents and commercial business owners within a 3 km radius, the neighborhood public consultation approval rating for the High-solids plug-flow digestion plant is 76 %.
COM-CIV-8GU：For the Continuous stirred-tank wet digestion facility, the neighborhood public consultation approval rating measured across residents and commercial business owners within a 3 km radius stands at 88 %.
